subject: Stitched closure lanes and contingency sequencing for MSA/DPA
messages:
From: Claire Donnelly <claire@noventishealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing questions

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. Procurement at Noventis needs a clear sequencing plan before we move the deal to legal intake. Two items I need from Redwood to build our internal MAP: a) a concise list of order-form dependencies (what clauses require DPA signoff vs. what can be staged post-signature), and b) evidence windows for SOC2 / data residency that our InfoSec will accept for pilot access.

We have a constrained calendar: finance needs a signed order form by 4/26 to hit our FY quarter close. If legal cannot complete the DPA/CSA by that time, procurement asked for an alternative: staged order with a conditional acceptance clause that ties final payment to DPA execution. Can Redwood operate under a staged acceptance or do you need the DPA signed before spinning up pilot capacity?

Attached a simple procurement calendar (noventis-eval-schedule.xlsx) to show our internal deadlines.

Appreciate any quick clarity — we are excited to move but need those guardrails documented for our legal and procurement teams.

Best,
Claire Donnelly
Sr. Procurement Program Manager
Noventis Health

Attachment: noventis-eval-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donnelly <claire@noventishealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing questions

Hi Claire — thanks for the calendar and the clear ask. High level: we can support a staged onboarding for pilot capacity (limited tokens/instances) while legal completes the DPA, provided we document acceptance gates and data handling constraints. I proposed looping Rishi to confirm the items that must be executed before any production access.

Quick answers up front:
- Order-form dependencies: Payment terms, core SLA, and order quantities can be captured in an initial order form. DPA can be a referenced document with an explicit contingency clause that ties final acceptance to DPA completion.
- Evidence windows: we can provide a current SOC 2 snapshot and a signed statement of data residency options within 3 business days of request.

Rishi / Laura — can you confirm the minimum legal gating items and safe-guard language we should offer as a temporary acceptance clause? I suggest the MAP reflect: staging limits (pilot capacity), escrow of final invoice until DPA, and a 30-day rollback window if DPA terms materially differ.

I’ll draft a short MAP and share in Drive; Claire, if that looks acceptable we can align on sign-off owners and dates.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Donnelly <claire@noventishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing questions

On Thu, Apr 5, 2028 at 10:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rishi / Laura — can you confirm the minimum legal gating items and safe-guard language we should offer as a temporary acceptance clause?

Hi all —

We can accept a staged order approach but want to ensure the following are explicit in the MAP and order-form language before we allow pilot access that includes customer data: 

1) Pilot scope limits: token cap, dataset scope, and retention windows. No broader production access until DPA executed.
2) Conditional acceptance clause: draft wording attached — ties the final invoice to DPA/CSA execution and requires a 30-day cure window.
3) Evidence delivery: we will produce a SOC 2 snapshot and a redacted architecture diagram. The SOC 2 snapshot will be current but note it is point-in-time — we recommend scheduling an evidence handoff milestone in the MAP.
4) Data handling controls: ephemeral KV cache for pilot, explicit prohibition on export of PII outside agreed paths.
5) Escrow/fallback: if DPA terms cannot be mutually agreed by milestone date, the MAP will default to a rollback of pilot capacity and refund schedule as noted in the conditional clause.

Attachment: SOC2-snapshot.pdf (evidence stub)
Attachment: conditional-acceptance-draft.docx (legal stub)

If procurement needs faster sign-off, we can accept a signature on the order form with an explicit DPA-conditional acceptance exhibit. That should satisfy finance timing while protecting Redwood risk. Laura — can you coordinate a short MAP doc with milestones and owners (we should show Legal owner, Procurement owner, and an Ops gate for evidence handoff)?

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Donnelly <claire@noventishealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing questions

Marissa / Rishi — this is helpful. Procurement is comfortable with the staged order approach if we get: (a) the conditional acceptance language in the order form, (b) SOC2 snapshot and evidence handoff date, and (c) a committed legal review calendar with redline turnaround times (we typically run a 48-72 hour review cadence for vendor DPAs at this stage).

One ask: can Redwood commit to producing the SOC2 snapshot and the redacted architecture within 72 hours of initial order signature? If so, we can move forward and I will push finance to accept the conditional payment hold.

Also attaching a short procurement constraints doc that lists our quarter-close requirement and illustrates acceptance owners.

Regards,
Claire
Attachment: noventis-constraints.pdf (procurement stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donnelly <claire@noventishealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Apr 2028 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing questions

Claire —

We can commit to the timeline. Proposed mutual action plan (short form) below — please confirm owners and milestone dates and we’ll convert to a signed MAP doc and append to the order form: 

Mutual Action Plan (short form) — Noventis / Redwood
- Milestone 1 (Order form sign): 2028-04-20 — Noventis signs order form with conditional acceptance exhibit. Owner: Noventis Procurement (Claire).
- Milestone 2 (Evidence handoff): 2028-04-23 — Redwood delivers SOC2-snapshot.pdf and redacted infra diagram. Owner: Redwood Legal/Ops (Rishi).
- Milestone 3 (Legal redline cycle): 2028-04-23 to 2028-04-26 — 48-hour review cadence, target execution of DPA by 2028-04-26. Owner: Noventis Legal / Redwood Legal.
- Milestone 4 (Pilot activation): 2028-04-27 — Limited pilot capacity enabled (token cap = 2M tokens / month). Owner: Redwood Onboarding (Laura).
- Contingency: If DPA is not executed by 2028-04-26, the conditional acceptance clause triggers a rollback and refund schedule outlined in the exhibit.

Next steps: Laura will create a Drive doc with the full MAP and the exact conditional wording Rishi attached; I’ll put a proposed order form with the exhibit in DocuSign and share the link. Once we have your confirmation on owners/dates I will route for signature and loop Finance.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference

Attachment: signed-orderform-draft.docx (order form stub)
